facts.text: I want my name in every paper in town, so tonight's dinner is for the cameras. Smile, Amos, and pass the rolls.
facts.why: Not found among Roxie's lines on the quote page. Her real lines include 'And that's showbiz, kid.' and 'I bet you want to know why I shot the bastard?' This one is printed in quote marks as her words.

vibe.verdict: The jail kitchen with Razzle Dazzle, Cellophane and the Cicero ice joke works, but the page is plain and the jazz club side is missing.
missing: All That Jazz at the Onyx (oysters note)
ideas: Swap 'Deep dish pizza' (a 1940s invention) for a 1920s dish such as 'Razzle dazzle fried oysters', note 'Billy Flynn's three ring circus.'
Swap 'Billy Flynn's Italian beef rolls' for 'Billy Flynn's five thousand dollar steak', note 'He asks one question first.'
Rename 'Bathtub gin fizz' to 'Hotel Cicero gin and ice', note 'Velma ran out of ice. Don't.'
Change the layout from a jail canteen to a nightclub or speakeasy format, to match the Onyx and the jazz age.
